title: unify private terraform state layout: extract gpu node-pools, iam, networking modules and migration helpers
author: Ayesha Patel
description: Unify the Terraform state layout for Private deployments by extracting GPU node pools, IAM roles/policies, and networking into reusable modules and providing a safe, scripted migration path for existing customer states. Motivation: previous private deployments duplicated resource layouts across regions/repos which made upgrades, drift detection, and autoscaling changes error-prone. This PR introduces canonical modules (modules/gpu-node-pool, modules/iam, modules/networking), updates example stacks to consume the modules, and adds scripts and documentation to perform an in-place state migration with minimal downtime. The migration is designed to be opt-in and reversible; default configs remain backwards-compatible for one release cycle. Key changes: 1) New modules with inputs for instance_type, gpu_count, preemptible, autoscaler policies; 2) IAM module that centralizes roles, service accounts, and least-privilege bindings used by the private installer; 3) Networking module that standardizes subnets, route tables, shared VPC attachments and peering where applicable; 4) State migration helpers: scripts/terraform/migrate_private_state.sh and a dry-run mode that emits terraform state mv commands; 5) Small refactors to examples/private/* and README updates with step-by-step migration instructions and rollback plan. Migration notes: run CI and plan in a staging environment first; the script runs terraform state list against the old layout, maps resources to the new module path and produces an idempotent sequence of terraform state mv commands which can be reviewed before applying. We included an automated integration test that exercises node pool scale-up/down and verifies IAM bindings post-migration. Rollback: retain old state backup and provide explicit reverse-mapping in scripts. Risk: state moves are inherently sensitive; follow the documented gating checklist in README and coordinate with SRE for protected customer environments. Related Linear: ENG-1941, ENG-2050.
